title: Algebraic multiplicities and reality for powers of endomorphisms
statement:
Let $K$ be an algebraically closed field, $V$ a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space, and $A:V\to V$ a $K$-linear endomorphism. Let $r=\dim_KV$, let $n\ge1$ be an integer, and enumerate the roots of the characteristic polynomial $\chi_A(T)$ [def-weil-characteristic-polynomial] as $\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_r$, with algebraic root multiplicities [def-weil-root-multiplicity]. Then
$$\chi_{A^n}(T)=\prod_{j=1}^r(T-\alpha_j^n),\qquad \det(1-TA^n\mid V)=\prod_{j=1}^r(1-T\alpha_j^n).$$
The second polynomial is the reverse characteristic polynomial [def-weil-reverse-characteristic-polynomial]. Thus multiplicities add when distinct eigenvalues have equal $n$th powers. If $\iota:K\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$ is a field isomorphism and the multiset $(\iota(\alpha_j))_j$ is invariant under complex conjugation, then the multiset $(\iota(\alpha_j^n))_j$ is also invariant, and $\iota(\det(1-TA^n\mid V))\in\mathbf R[T]$. No invertibility or semisimplicity of $A$ is assumed; $r=0$ gives empty products equal to $1$.

proof.text: Use the already-proved basis form of [p-linear-triangular], Module.End.exists_basis_isUpperTriangular_toMatrix, to choose a basis b with upper triangular matrix B for A. Mathlib Matrix.charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular gives the product of X minus the diagonal entries. Taking roots and using Polynomial.roots_multiset_prod_X_sub_C identifies the multiset of diagonal entries with the given enumeration alpha. No reversal of the basis or fresh determinant induction is needed.

Mathlib Matrix.BlockTriangular.pow shows B^k stays upper triangular. By induction on k, its ith diagonal entry is B_ii^k: in the diagonal entry of B^k B, every summand with j<i vanishes in B^k and every one with i<j vanishes in B. The base case is the identity matrix, also for the empty index set. Apply Matrix.charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular to B^n and transport the diagonal multiset equality through a -> X-C(a^n). This proves the characteristic-polynomial product for A^n.

By [def-weil-reverse-characteristic-polynomial], reverse the characteristic-polynomial product. The proved source-library identity Polynomial.reverse_multiset_prod_X_sub_C gives the product of 1-C(a^n) X, equivalently 1-X C(a^n). Zero eigenvalues and empty multisets are allowed.

Take roots of the powered characteristic-polynomial product with Polynomial.roots_multiset_prod_X_sub_C. Polynomial.count_roots identifies root multiplicity with the count in that multiset; Multiset.count_map and Fintype.card_subtype identify this count with Nat.card of the fibre of j -> alpha_j^n. This includes collisions, repeated roots and positive characteristic.

Map the conjugation-stable multiset equality through z -> z^n. Conjugation and the field isomorphism preserve powers, giving conjugation stability for the powered multiset. Map that equality through z -> 1-X C(z) and take products. Polynomial coefficient maps commute with products, so the mapped reverse characteristic polynomial Q is fixed by coefficientwise conjugation. Complex.conj_eq_iff_re says each coefficient equals the inclusion of its real part. Construct P explicitly by applying Complex.re to the finitely supported coefficients of Q and prove coefficientwise that P.map Complex.ofRealHom=Q.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q07-972bbd64a (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: There are no new nodes. The item statement, stmt_deps and source are unchanged from the base; only a 5-step proof was added. Source: main-20261015 thm-zl-real-mixed-by-curves.proof.md, paragraph 1 ('powering preserves conjugation-stable spectra'); the item matches it exactly and is not weakened. Step 1: p-linear-triangular gives a complete invariant flag over the algebraically closed K; an adapted basis, reversed, gives a lower-triangular matrix (direction checked). Step 2: lem-weil-pbc-block-triangular-determinant with p=1, q=s-1, by induction, gives det = product of diagonal entries over K[T]. Cancellation plus Q(c)≠0 identifies (d_i) with the root multiset of def-weil-root-multiplicity exactly. Step 3: lower-triangular matrices are closed under products, so B^n has diagonal d_i^n; this gives chi_{A^n} and det(1-TA^n). Step 4: multiplicities add at collisions; separability is not needed, so it holds when char K divides n. Step 5: an occurrence permutation shows the conjugated product equals the product, so the polynomial is in R[T]. Tested r=0, A=0, the Jordan block J_2(λ) (chi_{J^n}=(T-λ^n)^2), diag(1,-1) at n=2, char p with n=p, and diag(i,-i). Duplicate search: lem-wf-trace-power-eigenvalues gives traces only and p-linear-spectra covers tensor/exterior/dual spectra, so neither is a duplicate. Batch-5 flag on p-linear-triangular (sec-trace-formula): accepted as a declared tool_use. It is generic linear algebra with no stmt_deps and a sorry-free Lean declaration (Module.End.exists_le_map_le_finrank_eq_succ). Neither the trace-formula leaf nor the Poincaré-duality leaf gives it. Within sec-trace-formula it is used only by lem-zl-log-det-identity, which belongs to the zeta-rationality consequence, not to the proof of the trace formula or of Poincaré duality. Other batch-5 split nodes already cite it. No SGA source is used and no changes were made.

lean.statement: theorem power_spectrum_conjugation {K : Type u} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] {V : Type v} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] (A : V →ₗ[K] V) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (α : Fin (Module.finrank K V) → K) (hα : A.charpoly.roots = Finset.univ.val.map α) : (A ^ n).charpoly = ∏ j, (X - C (α j ^ n)) ∧ (A ^ n).charpolyRev = ∏ j, (1 - X * C (α j ^ n)) ∧ (∀ β : K, rootMultiplicity β (A ^ n).charpoly = Nat.card {j : Fin (Module.finrank K V) // α j ^ n = β}) ∧ (∀ ι : K ≃+* ℂ, Finset.univ.val.map (fun j ↦ star (ι (α j))) = Finset.univ.val.map (fun j ↦ ι (α j)) → Finset.univ.val.map (fun j ↦ star (ι (α j ^ n))) = Finset.univ.val.map (fun j ↦ ι (α j ^ n)) ∧ ∃ P : ℝ[X], P.map Complex.ofRealHom = (A ^ n).charpolyRev.map ι.toRingHom)

reviewed_lean.note: Statement matches the node clause by clause: alg-closed K, finite-dim V in an independent universe, arbitrary A, n≥1; roots enumerated with multiplicity via charpoly.roots = univ.val.map α (satisfiable since the charpoly splits); charpoly and charpolyRev(=charpoly.reverse) products; collision multiplicity via Nat.card of the fibre; conditional ι:K≃+*ℂ conjugation-stable multiset plus a real polynomial P. Edge cases r=0, A=0, Jordan block, diag(1,-1), char p with n=p and diag(i,-i) checked. Source thm-zl-real-mixed-by-curves.proof.md para 1 matches. Node diff is lean only; lean.statement verbatim.
